lines.en: This is such a great day.
You see, at my house, I got a wife and three beautiful daughters.
But this trip, it is the one time a year I get to pee standing up.
Somebody shot me in the head!
Oh, my God, oh, my God, oh, my God!
Ron, get your hat! Ron, I have your hat!
Are you in a lot of pain?
I was shot in the head with a shotgun!
Ron, it's actually not that serious. I just need you to stay calm, okay?
Yeah, I'm just gonna stay angry. I find that relaxes me.
Okay, Ron, we called 911, and they're gonna send a ranger.
Oh, damn! This is a mess.
The rangers won't let us come back next year.
You know what? We're not gonna think about that right now.
You guys, can you just put them on the day bed in the carcass room?
Yes, my God! Someone's over there!
Okay, Jerry, Jerry's here. Here's your scotch, Ron.
Hey, you know what is great?
Anne's gonna take care of you.
And Anne is the best nurse in North America.
Did you, did you shoot me?
There was a bird kinda near me, and I know how desperate you were to prove yourself.
Ron, I swear to God, I've never shot anyone.
Well, you better find out who it was, and then purchase them a coffin, because I'm gonna rip them apart!
When I look at my palm, I see a lady's mouth French kissing a dog.
Well, the pain medication I gave you is pretty strong.
Donna uses it for menstrual cramps.
But I washed them down with plenty of fluids.
No, Ron, you cannot drink scotch with this.
You're gonna need to purge right now, okay?
No, I'm not wasting 20 years of scotch.
I'm sorry, we have to do this.
This is for your own good.
Well, good news is Ron is resting comfortably.
Although, I am hoping that he has some memory loss.
On a scale of one to Chris Brown, how pissed is he?
Well, he's very curious about who shot him.
So, if you did it, just say I did it.
Come on, person who shot Ron.
Look, I think it's a little weird that nobody wants to admit
that they shot Ron in the head.
He has seemed really depressed lately.
He was shot in the back of the head.
He loves the back of his head.
He would never shoot himself there.
It could have been someone else that shot Ron.
You think someone is hunting us?
Man is the most dangerous game.
I did smell something out there, and it wasn't human.
We should cover ourselves in mud.
It could still be out there.
Scare him off and shoot over his head.
I'm gonna shoot under its head.
It's Craig from -- from Reinhold Mercedes!
He's talking about you in his sleep.
No one will admit they shot Ron, and no one saw it happen.
Listen, I heard about the accident, and I need to know who is responsible.
